description: Scientific paper quality rubric for the automated paper-grading pipeline. Gemini evaluates paper metadata against four weighted categories (summing to a maximum of 100 points, with negative penalties for funding bias and predatory journals) to produce a total score mapped to letter grades A-E.

grade_bands.label: Fair — moderate quality or notable limitations
Poor — low-quality, high-bias, or penalized evidence

categories.label: Study Design / Hierarchy
categories.description: Where the study sits on the evidence hierarchy. Apply AMSTAR 2 risk-of-bias reasoning for systematic reviews and ROB2 reasoning for RCTs.

score_tiers.example: Systematic review or meta-analysis of human trials, low AMSTAR 2 risk of bias
Double-blind, placebo-controlled human RCT, low-to-moderate ROB2 risk of bias
Single-blind or open-label human RCT; or well-controlled prospective cohort study
Observational/cross-sectional human study, or well-designed animal model
In-vitro/cell study, single case report, or non-peer-reviewed preprint

categories.label: Journal / Publisher Rigor
categories.description: Impact factor, peer-review rigor, and publisher reputation. Reputable journals earn up to +10 points; predatory publishers or known blacklisted journals penalize score down to -5.

score_tiers.example: Top-tier journal (impact factor > 10), e.g. NEJM, JAMA, Nature, The Lancet
High-quality specialty journal (impact factor 4-10)
Reputable mid-tier peer-reviewed journal (impact factor 1-4)
Low-impact or lesser-known peer-reviewed journal
Neutral / unidentified publisher
Predatory journal, vanity press, unvetted pay-to-publish outlet, or fake peer review

categories.label: Methodology & Sample
categories.description: Sample size, diversity, human vs animal vs cell model, number of included studies in reviews, and overall statistical power.

score_tiers.example: Comprehensive systematic review (20+ studies) or very large (500+), diverse human sample
Large (200-499) human sample, or solid review (10-19 studies)
Moderate (50-199) human sample, or narrow demographic
Small (<50) human sample, or animal model study
Cell/in-vitro study only, single case report, or sample details omitted

categories.label: Funding & Commercial Bias
categories.description: Evaluates funding sources and commercial conflicts of interest. Independent funding earns up to +5 points; if a validated metric (AMSTAR 2, ROB2, etc.) confirms low risk of bias, award full max score (+5). Undisclosed funding defaults to a neutral +2; heavy industry influence penalizes score (down to -15).

score_tiers.example: Fully independent funding (government/university grant), no conflicts of interest; OR validated low risk of bias via formal metrics (AMSTAR 2, ROB2)
Mixed funding (partial industry support), conflicts disclosed and transparently managed
Neutral / funding source undisclosed or not mentioned in available metadata
Primarily industry-funded or manufacturer-funded with author affiliations
Clear marketing bias, undisclosed industry funding, or suspicious commercial interference
